programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: In California, Guy takes Marc Summers to check out fried rice in a bowl and burrito; then, he's off to Vegas with Hunter for real deal Jamaican and to Florida for lobster meatballs and pork cheek empanadas.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: Guy Fieri's visiting restaurants owned by familiar Food Network faces; in Studio City, Calif., chef Antonia Lofaso is cooking up global flavors, and in Rapid City, S.D., chef Justin Warner is serving up righteous ramen and dynamite dumplings.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: Guy Fieri road trips across America to check out classic greasy spoons; with a new generation of owners and delicious homemade food, these are the kind of places that make America special.

programs.desc: Guy Fieri's on a tour of the Southeast, starting with an out-of-bounds brisket po'boy in Port Allen, LA; then, Guy finds shrimp rolls in Gainesville, Fla.; a Korean-Mexican mashup in Atlanta is rocking big-time bulgogi cheesesteaks.
